The first wedge’s exponent is overwritten and cramped; the original already records the n-1|n uncertainty there. See crops/136_scan139_L332.jpg.
rows.note: Retain the second exponent n exactly as written. The row’s n+1 is a mathematical correction based on the rank and exact sequence, not a recovered missing stroke. The first exponent is not as clean as the row’s abbreviated quotation suggests, so retain the original \deleted{\unsure{*}}\unsure{n-1|n}; this row provides no optical basis for removing that uncertainty. No independent proof of the claimed canonical identification is asserted.
